name: Mutsu Takatomi
source: Owner of a local shrine and [url=/c17978]Sakura[/url]'s brother. He s worried about his sister, being a single parent, often over-working her self. Because of that, he's in favor of [url=/c17979]Sawako[/url] becoming the protagonist's guardian, so that he leaves the Hinata household and decreasing the burden on Sakura.
